title: Kanneere Keerthanalaaye – Dr.Asher Andrew Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: మారని దేవా మహోన్నత ఇదియే మా కృతజ్ఞత
అర్హతే లేని నాపై అంతులేని కృపను చూపి..
నే తూలిన ప్రతి క్షణాన భుజములపై మోసితివి
నమ్మకమే లేని నన్ను నమ్మిన ప్రేమవు నీవు
నీ స్పర్శ తాకిన వారే సాక్షులుగా నిలిచినారే
మా ప్రేమ మారినా నీ ప్రేమ మారదు
గొర్రె పిల్ల రక్తముతో మా కథనే వ్రాసావే
english: Maaran destaca mahonnatha idiye maa kruthagnatha
Arhathe leni naapai antholeni krupanu choopi..
Ne thoolina prathi kshanaana bhujamulai mosithivi
Nammakame leni nannu nammina premavu neevu
Nee sparsha thaakina vaare saakshuluga nilichinaare
Maa prema maarina nee prema maaradu
Gorre pilla rakthamutho maa kathane vraasaave
translation: Chorus:
My tears became hymns, my wounds became songs…
You have watched over me and you will keep saving me,
You have carried me and you will keep carrying me.
O unchanging, most high God, this is our gratitude,
How can I ever repay your debt?
Verse 1:
Showing boundless grace upon someone completely unworthy,
You called me with love and carried me like a father.
Every single time I stumbled, You bore me on Your shoulders.
You are the love that trusted even me, who had no faithfulness.
Verse 2:
You fought the battles I could not even see,
You protected me from dangers I didn’t even know.
You abundantly blessed me with things I never even asked for,
Your grace is far stronger than my weakness.
Verse 3:
Giving us promises and building us as a living temple,
Those touched by Your presence stand as living witnesses.
You continue to nourish us out of Your abundance,
Even if our love changes, Your love never changes.
Verse 4:
You brought forth glory even in places devoid of it,
You have been my ever-present helper and my Ebenezer.
You wrote our story with the blood of the Lamb,
Your calling never changes and it will never fail.
intro: Kanneere Keerthanalaaye is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & sung by Dr.Asher Andrew. This song was released on July 12, 2026, through Dr. Asher Andrew YouTube Channel.
